stylePrompt: In the style of Jakub Rozalski — oil painting aesthetic, rich earthy tones, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, dark atmospheric mood, highly detailed painterly brushwork, folk horror sensibility, 17th-century colonial New England setting, muted palette of deep greens, ash greys, burnt umbers, and candlelight golds, ominous yet beautiful, fog and shadow, top-down hex tile perspective

notes.perspective: Top-down isometric or near-top-down view to fit a hex tile grid
notes.resolution: Suggest 256x256 or 512x512 per tile/unit; units should be centred on transparent background
notes.naming: Use the 'id' field as the output filename, e.g. grass.png, hero.png
